### iliad-096 (15.471–558)

| Greek | English (`l` / `i`) | reason |
|---|---|---|
| τὸν δ’ ἠμείβετ’ ἔπειτα μέγας Τελαμώνιος Αἴας (15.471, whole-line reply formula) | "Him then answered great Telamonian Ajax:" / "Then great Telamonian Ajax answered him:" | avoided: "Ajax, son of Telamon"; the table's reply formula (1.172, 6.263) with μέγας Τελαμώνιος Αἴας (12.364) and Τελαμώνιος Αἴας "Telamonian Ajax" |
| ὦ πέπον (15.472) | "O good one" / "My good fellow" | the published rendering (9.252, 11.765), unchanged; the note says the meaning is not known and the tone here is friendly |
| βλαφθέντα βέλεμνα (15.484, 15.489; βλάπτω "hinder, harm", βέλεμνον a collective for what is shot or thrown) | "hindered" · "missiles" / "made useless" · "missiles" | avoided: "damaged", "disabled", "thwarted"; "shaft" is kept for βέλος (1.51, 1.382), so the different word βέλεμνα takes "missiles", which the βέλος row had turned down for βέλος only; the same English at both occurrences |
| ἀνδρὸς ἀριστῆος (15.489) | "of a best man" / "of one of the best men" | avoided: "champion"; follows the table's ἀριστῆες "the best men" (2.404) |
| Διόθεν (15.489) | "from Zeus" / "by Zeus" | the ending -θεν marks the source |
| ἀρίγνωτος … ἀλκή (15.490) | "easily-known" … "might" / "easily known" … "might" | the Odyssey's ἀρίγνωτος (the table's "easily-known"); ἀλκή keeps "might" (4.234) |
| μινύθω (μινύθῃ, μινύθει, 15.491–493; transitive, Zeus as subject) | "lessens" / "lessens" | avoided: "dwindles", "wastes"; the verb has Zeus as its subject in both lines and takes an object (ὅτινας, μένος) |
| ἄρκιον (15.502) | "assured" / "sure" (+ note: usual sense "sufficient, certain") | follows the table's ἄρκιον "assured" (2.393); `i` is made "the choice is sure" because the Greek has an infinitive pair |
| ἐμβαδόν (15.505; rare) | "on foot" / "on foot" | avoided: "step by step", "stepping"; the note explains the point |
| ἦ ἔλπεσθ’ (15.504) · ἦ οὐκ ἀκούετε (15.506) | "Truly do you expect" · "Truly do you not hear" / "Do you really expect" · "Do you really not hear" | the table's ἔλπομαι "expect" and the 9.40 pattern; the same ἦ gets the same English at both questions |
| οὐ μὰν ἔς γε χορὸν κέλετ’ ἐλθέμεν, ἀλλὰ μάχεσθαι (15.508) | "Truly not to a dance does he bid them come, but to fight." / "It is not to a dance that he bids them come, but to fight." | κέλομαι "bid" (as ἀνώγω "bids" 4.263); avoided: "orders", "calls" |
| αὐτοσχεδίῃ (15.510) | "at close quarters" / "at close quarters" | avoided: "in close combat" (kept for αὐτοσταδίῃ, 13.325); αὐτοσχεδόν "at close quarters" (the table) |
| νόος καὶ μῆτις (15.509) | "mind and cunning" / "mind or cunning" | follows the table's νόον καὶ μῆτιν (7.447) |
| στρεύγεσθαι (15.512) | "to be worn out" / "to be worn out" | avoided: "worn down" (kept for τείρω, 5.352), "pressed", "distressed"; στρεύγομαι "be drained, exhausted" |
| ἕνα χρόνον (15.511) | "for one time" / "once and for all" | avoided: "at once", "for ever" |
| χειρότερος (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι χειροτέροισιν, 15.513) | "worse" / "worse" | avoided: "weaker", "inferior", "lesser"; the comparative of κακός |
| ὧδ’ αὔτως (15.513) | "so, idly" / "like this, to no purpose" | follows the table's αὔτως "just so, idly" |
| ἄρκιον … ἤρκεσε (ἀρκέω, 15.529, 15.534) | "warded it off" · "warded off" / "warded it off" · "warded off" | follows the table's ἐπαρκέω "ward off" (2.873); avoided: "sufficed", "protected", "was enough" |
| πυκινὸς … θώρηξ (15.529) | "the solid breastplate" / "the solid breastplate" | follows the table's πυκινός "solid" (4.392, 5.751) and θώρηξ "breastplate" (3.332) |
| γυάλοισιν ἀρηρότα (15.530; ἀραρίσκω "fit together") | "fitted with hollows" / "fitted with its hollow plates" | the table's γύαλον "hollow" (5.98); avoided: "fitted with curved plates" (decides the shape), "jointed"; note says the construction is not certain |
| ἀλεωρήν (δηΐων ἀνδρῶν ἀλεωρήν, 15.533) | "a defence from hostile men" / "a defence against enemy men" | the published rendering (12.57), unchanged |
| ξεῖνος (of Euphetes, 15.532) | "guest-friend" / "guest-friend" | the table's ξεῖνος "guest-friend" of the bond (9.18), not "stranger" |
| κύμβαχον ἀκρότατον (15.536; κύμβαχος rare, here the top of the helmet) | "the topmost crown" / "the very top" (+ note: sense not certain) | avoided: "peak", "crest" (kept for λόφος); the other occurrence (5.586) is the adverb-like "head-down" |
| ἵππειον λόφον (15.537) | "the horse crest" / "the horsehair crest" | avoided: "horse-tailed" (ἵππουρις), "horse-maned" (ἱππιοχαίτης, 6.469); λόφος keeps "crest" |
| νέον φοίνικι φαεινός (15.538) | "newly shining with crimson" / "bright with fresh crimson" | φοῖνιξ "crimson" (4.141, 6.219), φαεινός "shining" |
| εἷος … τόφρα (15.539–540) | "As long as … meanwhile" / "While … " | avoided: "until" |
| στῆ δ’ εὐρὰξ σὺν δουρὶ λαθών (15.541) | "stood sideways with his spear, unnoticed" / "took his stand to one side with his spear, unseen" | the table's εὐρὰξ "stood sideways" / "took his stand to one side" (11.251); λαθών "unnoticed" / "unseen" |
| ἐεισάσθην (15.544; dual aorist) | "rushed" / "rushed" | avoided: "set out", "were eager"; the verb is related to ἵεμαι "hasten" |
| λιάζομαι (λιάσθη 15.520 · ἐλιάσθη 15.543) | "bent aside" · "bent down" / "swerved aside" · "sank down" | avoided: "gave way" (as with ἀλίαστος "relentless"), "collapsed"; one verb "bend, give way", the direction decided by the adverb |
| ἀπήμβροτεν (15.521) | "missed" / "missed" | avoided: "failed to hit"; ἀφαμαρτάνω "miss" |
| κασιγνήτοισι (15.545) | "brothers" / "brothers" | the table's κασίγνητος "brother" (8.330, 11.257); the note says the word can reach to near kin |
| πᾶσι μάλα (15.545–546) | "to all of them" / "to all … every one" | avoided: "very many", "all very much" |
| ἐνένιπεν (15.546, 15.552) | "rebuked" / "rebuked" | the table's ἐνίπτω "rebuke" (3.438) |
| ἔπος τ’ ἔφατ’ ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζεν (15.552, male subject and object) | "and spoke a word, and called him by name:" / "and spoke, calling him by name:" | the table's 1.361 / 4.610 pattern |
| μεθήσομεν (15.553) | "shall we slacken" / "are we to slacken" | the table's μεθίημι "let go, slacken" (4.234, 6.523 absolute); future indicative used deliberatively, no object stated |
| ἐντρέπεται (15.554, ἐντρέπομαι + gen.) | "heed" / "heed" | avoided: "have regard for", "be moved by", "be ashamed before"; ἐντρέπομαι "turn toward, heed" |
| ἀνεψιός (15.554) | "cousin" / "cousin" | the table's ἀνεψιός "cousin" (9.464, 10.519) |
| ἕπω · ἕπομαι (ἕπουσιν 15.555, ἕπευ 15.556) | "are busy" · "follow" / "are busy" · "follow me" | avoided: "attend", "go about" |
| ἀποσταδόν (15.556) | "standing apart" / "from a distance" | avoided: "aloof"; ἀπο- + ἵστημι (the note says "at a distance") |
| κατ’ ἄκρης (15.557–558) | "from the top down" / "from top to bottom" | avoided: "utterly", "entirely" |
| Names, new to the table: Σχεδίος · Περιμήδης · Φωκῆες · Λαοδάμας · Ὦτος · Κυλλήνιος · Ἐπειοί · Κροῖσμος · Δόλοψ · Λαμπετίδης · Λάμπος · Λαομεδοντιάδης · Εὐφήτης · Ἐφύρη · Σελλήεις · Ἱκεταονίδης · Μελάνιππος · Περκώτη | Schedius · Perimedes · Phocians · Laodamas · Otus · the Cyllenian · Epeians · Croesmus · Dolops · Lampetus’-son · Lampus · Laomedon’s-son · Euphetes · Ephyre · Selleeis · Hicetaon’s-son · Melanippus · Percote | same, with "son of …" for patronymics in `i` and "of Cyllene" for Κυλλήνιος in `i`; Πουλυδάμας keeps "Polydamas" (12.80) and Πάνθου υἱός "the son of Panthous"; Λαμπετίδης is rendered from the form given ("Lampetus’-son" / "son of Lampetus"), and the note says Λάμπος is named as his father; Φυλεΐδης keeps "Phyleus’-son" / "son of Phyleus" (5.72) |
| πρυλέων ἡγεμόνα (15.517) · ἀρχόν (15.516, 15.519) | "leader of the foot-soldiers" · "commander" / same | the table's πρυλέες "foot-soldiers" (5.744, 12.77) and ἀρχός "commander" (4.464); ἡγεμών "leader" |

Odyssey-shared lines: 15.480–481 reuse the English of odyssey-107 and of the Iliad at 3.336–337 (iliad-019), unchanged. No departure from the Odyssey English in this part.
